title: Lineage Report
text: Firmware Archaeology, final comparison. The relic grid's code and ours share a root, then split, then split again: a family tree of caretakers. 97.3% at the surface. Underneath, one block the comparison can't open, in theirs or in ours. Both copies are marked the same way: reserved.

choices.label: Try to open it
choices.reply: Access level insufficient. Reserved for a use not yet listed.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.reply: Logged. The technician who signed off the comparison asks what it's reserved for. We don't know.
